purpose: Phase 1A structured ingestion report; no GO/DROP decision

fingerprint.input: source_payload only, including unknown source keys and missing/null/blank distinctions
fingerprint.serialization: UTF-8 Unicode JSON, recursively sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN

application_period_derivation.supported: explicit full ranges YYYY-M-D / YYYY.M.D / YYYY/M/D or YYYY년 M월 D일, both bounds include year, separator~ / ～ / 〜
application_period_derivation.validation: calendar-valid, start<=end; no inferred year or recurring period
application_period_derivation.unknown: free text budget/exhaustion/monthly/partial ranges remain raw and NULL; not an error
application_period_derivation.maintenance: existing normalizer period() only, explicit date refresh updates derived dates atomically, preserves every other column including source fingerprint and lifecycle
application_period_derivation.basis: 2026-10-04 IMP-011; dev one missed dot range observed
